_why: A hazard type is enabled in the app only if the model meets every threshold on the held-out SH17 split. Precision and recall targets come from the proposal. Specificity was added after the evaluation showed that most test photos contain a violation, so precision and recall alone cannot reveal a model that flags almost everything; a model that wrongly flags compliant workers erodes trust (alarm fatigue). Latency is the proposal's 20 s target.
